scientific_risk: Stage elapsed_seconds uses time.perf_counter and therefore includes an external process stop that overlaps a stage.
acceptance_rule: No sealed stage elapsed_seconds may be greater than or equal to pause_duration_seconds; an indistinguishable stage must be rerun under the same frozen contract before downstream replay.
recovery_boundary: Recovery may reuse completed checkpoints and rerun only tasks lacking uncontaminated completion; it may not change source, inputs, workers, evaluations, seeds, streams, arms, or result inclusion rules.
